proxy_assumptions: Three data qubits encode logical |+> as a GHZ state.
Two ideal ancillas measure adjacent ZZ stabilizers for three rounds.
Equation (9) is inserted on data qubits at the start of every round.
All syndrome extraction, reset, and final measurement operations are ideal.
Final logical-X failure is the odd parity of the three X-basis data measurements.
The unpublished Plaquette circuit-location and decoder conventions are not reconstructed.

decision.reason: The Clifford branch matches the paper, while the coherent branch misses by more than the declared 0.05 tolerance. Reconstruct circuit-location, frame, and decoder semantics before adding a sector-aware backend or opening Fig. 8.

boundary: The public parameters reproduce the Clifford result and the direction of the coherent-vs-twirled gap, but not the paper full-state value. Exact paper-level reproduction requires the unpublished circuit-location, frame, and decoder conventions.
